questions.prompt: The sick boy stood ___ the door waiting for the doctor. (A on, B at, C over, D in)
steps: At the door means by the doorway.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: There is ___ juice in the glass. (A some, B any, C a, D many)
steps: Use some with an uncountable noun in an affirmative statement.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She always ___ before sleeping and after waking up. (A pray, B will pray, C prays, D praying)
steps: She takes prays for a habitual present action.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My mother is a doctor. ___ works at Umoja dispensary. (A He, B We, C They, D She)
steps: She refers to mother.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: She bought two ___ of bread. (A loaf, B loafs, C loaves, D loavies)
steps: The plural of loaf changes f to ves.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: James prefers milk ___ juice. (A but, B to, C than, D with)
steps: The construction is prefer one thing to another.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: After paying, the shopkeeper gave us a ___. (A receipt, B ticket, C bill, D buyer)
steps: A receipt records payment already made.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Pupils were punished ___ they made noise. (A and, B but, C because, D so)
steps: Because introduces the cause of punishment.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Yesterday I went to school early ___ the morning. (A at, B on, C for, D in)
steps: Use in the morning.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Maria, Agness and I ___ new uniforms. (A have, B has, C were, D are)
steps: A plural subject takes have to express possession.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: We watched a football ___. (match, march)
steps: A football game is a match; march is a walk or a month.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Every child has the ___ to education. (right, write)
steps: Right means an entitlement.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Grandmother ___ people. (heels, heals)
steps: Heal means make well; heels are parts of feet.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His ___ cried after bee stings. (son, sun)
steps: Son names a child; sun is the star.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Jacob and James ___ at church on Sundays. (meat, meet)
steps: Meet is the verb for coming together.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: The ___ cares for patients in the ward. Arrange sunre.
steps: Use every letter once to make nurse.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: His ___ has the seat number and departure time. Arrange citkte.
steps: The letters make ticket.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My ___ love me. Arrange esraptn.
steps: The letters make parents.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: One day I ___ to market with my father. (go)
steps: The story describes a completed past visit.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: People were ___ and buying things. (sell)
steps: Were plus selling forms past continuous.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: My father ___ rice, fruit and vegetables. (buy)
steps: Bought is the simple past of buy.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: After buying everything we ___ home. (come)
steps: Came is the simple past of come.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What happened after Amani's goats wandered off?
steps: The first paragraph explicitly states this.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: Why did Amani and his friends split up?
steps: The second paragraph links their unsuccessful search with splitting up.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: They had searched the tall grass without finding the goats, so they searched different places.

questions.prompt: How did Amani feel when he found the goats?
steps: The passage states his emotion.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.

questions.prompt: What did he do after finding the goats?
steps: The final paragraph states his first action after finding them.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: He called his friends to tell them he had found the goats.

questions.prompt: What did Amani promise?
steps: The final sentence supplies his promise.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: To look after his goats more carefully from that day.
